messages:
tara: Heads-up: started seeing a cluster of fncall schema errors for the payments-parser route around 09:03 UTC. ~230 rejects over 20m.
ben: yikes. are these coming from one client or many?
tara: mostly the web SDK (v2.0.1) and some server-side customers sending richer payloads (extra metadata field). Validator flags: unexpected_field + enum mismatch.
jason: current behavior: strict validation -> 400 to caller, increment counter. No DLQ, no payload retention. We can't replay to reproduce.
niya: For debugging we need a safe replay surface. Idea: DLQ that stores redacted request samples + metadata. Not a full logging stream — sampled and encrypted.
ashok: we also need to consider routing: if a route starts rejecting a lot due to schema drift, should SmartRouter downgrade to a permissive variant automatically to reduce breakage?
tara: interesting. automatic permissive fallback could keep apps alive, but might mask bugs. We need policy: auto-fallback only for internal canaries or orgs that opt in.
ben: Console implications: Per-route panel with reject rate sparkline, DLQ toggle (off/on/sample %), and a "permit fallback" toggle. Default fallback = off.
jason: Security/Billing: if replays are allowed, replays must be flagged diagnostic and not incur customer billing. Also replay must not call external webhooks/tools. Use a local simulator.
niya: Telemetry: emit metrics: fncall.schema.rejects.count, fncall.schema.rejects.pct (per-route), fncall.dlq.sampled.count. Tag keys: org_id, route, validator_code.
ashok: UX: console should present a collapsed sample payload with redacted tokens and allow export to S3 or download as encrypted archive for enterprise.
tara: storage: propose DLQ objects stored in object store encrypted with envelope keys; if customer provides KMS key use that. Retention and sampling configurable per-org.
ben: rollout plan: (1) API feature flag behind ff_canary_fncall_dlq (2) internal testing org + infra team (3) small pilot with partner orgs (4) wider opt-in. Console UI gated until pilot stable.
jason: quota model: add "diagnostic_replay_credits" bucket. Free tier: 0 credits. Enterprise: assign monthly credits or bill per replay batch. Add hard cap and alerts.
niya: alerts: create alert if schema rejects > 0.5% of traffic for 10m and absolute rejects > 100 in 10m. Auto-create ticket and notify product + infra.
tara: edgecases: streaming fncalls - we should store the final assembled object and the last valid partials. Also nested schema union collisions need better error messages in the Console (line-level pointers).
ashok: important: policy for permissive fallback: must log that fallback was used in trace and tag responses with fallback=true. Also allow customers to opt-out of automatic fallback entirely via org config.
ben: Console widget mockups: show per-route toggles, DLQ health (queue depth, sampled rate), replay history with actor + timestamp, replay outcome (simulation only).
jason: replay security: require MFA + RBAC role 'replayer' to trigger. Every replay emits audit event with hash of original payload and who ran it.
tara: sample config sketch we can store with route config:
```json
{"route_config": {"payments-parser": {"schema_dlq": {"enabled": true, "sample_pct": 0.2, "retention_days": 14, "encryption_kms": "customer|platform", "replay_mode": "sandbox"}, "permissive_fallback": {"enabled": false}}}}
```
niya: can we unify validators with existing logging so queries like "show me last 24h rejects by validator_code" are cheap? We should index validator_code + route + org_id.
jason: implementation notes: small service to accept DLQ writes async (non-blocking path), apply redaction rules, encrypt and push to S3 + index to Dynamo/ElastiCache for recent samples. Replay pulls, decrypts, runs in isolated runner.
ashok: infra ask: what's the retention SLO? default 14 days, enterprise up to 90 days behind org agreement.
tara: next steps: Tara to draft RFC with config + telemetry + privacy considerations, Jason to sketch prototype service and replay runner, Niya to design Console mockups and error message wireframe, Ben to own rollout plan and billing hooks.
ops-bot: deploy: fncall-validator v3.1 rolled out to us-central-1 ; health checks passing.
ben: thanks all. Tara, ping when RFC is ready and I'll book a product/legal sync.
tara: will do. Thanks team :clap:
